newsitem.title: UK: Airtours rejigs board and management.
newsitem.headline: Airtours rejigs board and management.

text.p: Airtours Plc said on Friday it was appointing Sir Michael Bishop deputy chairman and Harry Coe deputy chief executive as part of a management rejig to refocus the company to reflect the spread of its overseas operations.
Coe retains his position as group finance director.

The UK holiday tour operator also said it was appointing Hugh Collinson chairman of the newly established accommodation division, consisting of 41 properties in the Sunwing Hotels division, the three resort complexes in a joint venture with Sol Melia Hotel Group and three cruise ships.

The group's aviation arm also gets a new chairman -- Mike Lee. The division will encompass Airtours International in the UK and Premiair, the largest leisure airline in Scandinavia, which Airtours snapped up in February.
The combined fleet is made up of 32 aircraft.

Tim Byrne, currently group financial controller, is appointed deputy finance director and Christer Sandahl, the chairman of the Scandinavian Leisure Group (SLG), joins the board. Airtours bought SLG in June 1994.

"We have made these changes to reflect the enlarged Airtours group which now comprises wholly-owned tour operating businesses in seven countries, significant accommodation and cruise interests and an enlarged aviation fleet," Airtours chairman David Crossland said in a statement.
"The changes will result in improved senior mangement focus and a more appropriate structure for the group going forwards."
